# method

Method.gg guide CLI.

## Global options

Pass these before the subcommand: `method --pretty <command> ...`.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--pretty` | boolean | false | Pretty-print JSON for human reading. Default output is compact JSON. |
| `--compact` | boolean | false | Truncate long string fields to reduce payload size. |
| `--fields` | str (repeatable) |  | Return only selected fields (dot paths). Repeat or pass comma-separated values. |
| `--fields-strict` | boolean | false | Fail when a requested --fields dot-path is missing from the payload. |
| `--profile` | str |  | Output profile preset: agent (default compact JSON), human (pretty JSON), debug (pretty JSON + diagnostics). |
| `--compact-max-chars` | int range | 280 | Maximum string length before --compact truncation adds an ellipsis. |

## method doctor

Report Method CLI readiness, capabilities, supported scope, and cache configuration.

## method search

Search the supported Method.gg guide families by free text.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | str | required | Query text to match against Method guide names and slugs. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--limit` | int range | 5 | Maximum results to return. |

## method resolve

Resolve a free-text query to the best matching Method guide plus the follow-up command.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | str | required | Free-text query to resolve to the single best Method guide. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--limit` | int range | 5 | Maximum candidates to inspect. |

## method guide-full

Fetch every navigation page of a Method guide with merged linked entities, builds, and analysis surfaces.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `guide_ref` | str | required | Guide slug or Method.gg guide URL. |

## method guide-export

Write every page of a Method guide to a local bundle directory for offline querying.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `guide_ref` | str | required | Guide slug or Method.gg guide URL. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--out` | path |  | Output directory. Defaults to ./method_exports/guide-<slug>. |

## method guide-query

Search an exported Method bundle on disk without touching the network.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bundle_ref` | str | required | Exported bundle directory produced by guide-export. |
| `query` | str | required | Query text to search within the exported Method bundle. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--limit` | int range | 5 | Maximum matches to return. |
| `--kind` | str (repeatable) |  | Restrict search kinds. Repeat or pass comma-separated values from: sections, navigation, linked_entities, build_references, analysis_surfaces. |
| `--section-title` | str |  | Restrict section searching to section titles containing this text. |
